paper.title: Robo-Cortex: A Self-Evolving Embodied Agent via Dual-Grain Cognitive Memory and Autonomous Knowledge Induction
paper.central_claim: Robo-Cortex 通过 Imagine-then-Verify 规划、双粒度认知记忆与自主知识归纳（AKI）形成可更新的导航启发式库，使具身导航在 IGNav/AR/AEQA 上优于强基线，并向未见环境迁移（最高 +15.30% SPL）。

provenance.notes: Opus aggregate seat via the configured claude-kimi type fable; no route probing. actual_model/session_id/receipt_ref are null because the subagent runtime exposes no verifiable provider receipt to this worker.

sections_read: Opus: pinned text read in full before opening seat records (abstract, method, experiments, all tables, appendices); targeted re-reads for every disputed field

arXiv v1 HTML has no appendix. 'Additional implementation details are provided in the supplementary material' (§4.1) refers to author-side material outside the arXiv record; per the SE-GPT precedent it is not part of the pinned document.

evidence.quote: Our core innovation is an Autonomous Knowledge Induction (AKI) mechanism that distills multimodal trajectories into a structured Navigation Heuristic Library for knowledge generalization.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者中心主张：AKI 把多模态轨迹蒸馏成导航启发式库。

evidence.quote: a static variant, Robo-Cortex, in which memory and heuristic guidance are fixed before testing for fair benchmark comparison
evidence.support_explanation: 静态变体的记忆/启发式在测试前固定，但文中未说明用哪些 episode 构建。

evidence.quote: Heuristics are first grouped by pattern identifier, and optionally further refined by semantic similarity over their textual descriptions and recommended strategies.
evidence.support_explanation: 启发式合并规则：按模式 ID 聚类+可选语义细化，再由 merger 模型泛化。

evidence.quote: Finally, high-confidence recurrent heuristics are fed back into the online system as structured guidance for short-term reflective analysis and planning.
evidence.support_explanation: 写回与下轮读取：高置信重复启发式进入 SRM/规划，无阈值数值、无验证。

evidence.quote: Successful episodes are prioritized over failed ones, and among successful episodes, shorter trajectories are retained as more efficient behavioral templates.
evidence.support_explanation: 记忆整合规则（成功优先、短轨迹优先）；仅为启发式保留，非实证门控。

evidence.quote: We separate the evaluation set into two disjoint halves
evidence.support_explanation: seen/unseen 是同一评测集的两半（episode 不相交），未说明场景是否重叠。

evidence.quote: We first analyze the contribution of Dual-Grain Cognitive Memory under repeated evaluation on the same split.
evidence.support_explanation: LPM 增益在同一 split 上重复多轮评测获得，等价于对相同 episode 的回放。

evidence.quote: heuristics transferred from the seen split generalize strongly to unseen environments
evidence.support_explanation: 作者对迁移结论的表述（“unseen environments”）。

evidence.quote: it does not surpass the fixed transferred-heuristic setting, suggesting that strong transferred heuristics already provide a high-quality prior and that aggressive online rewriting on limited unseen episodes may partially overwrite useful guidance.
evidence.support_explanation: 在线更新反而低于固定迁移启发式——如实的负结果，也说明缺少保留门控。

evidence.quote: manually written heuristics provide a useful prior, improving IGNav from 34.72% to 38.89% SR, but their benefits are less consistent on AR and AEQA.
evidence.support_explanation: 人工启发式对照，是对“归纳启发式”的有用替代解释检验。

evidence.quote: Compared with the strongest baseline, Robo-Cortex improves IGNav by +2.69% SR and +4.16% SPL, while also achieving the best AR success rate and the shortest trajectories on both AR and AEQA.
evidence.support_explanation: 静态主结果的作者表述；其数值见 Table 1。

evidence.quote: as the shared vision-language backbone for planning, memory analysis, and AKI
evidence.support_explanation: 同一 72B VLM 同时承担规划、记忆分析与 AKI；基线骨干未交代。

evidence.quote: The Basic Pipeline succeeds on 4/10 goals, showing that the closed-loop Imagine-then-Verify pipeline transfers to physical deployment
evidence.support_explanation: 真实世界仅报告基础管线 4/10，Robo-Cortex 无定量结果，仅一例定性。

evidence.quote: we have not yet systematically evaluated Robo-Cortex with different vision-language backbones or world models.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者承认骨干泛化未评估。

evidence.quote: This figure should be viewed as a case study of update behavior
evidence.support_explanation: 轮次动态图仅为个案。

evidence.quote: Additional implementation details are provided in the supplementary material.
evidence.support_explanation: 关键超参（窗口、阈值 δ、置信阈值等）在补充材料，不在固定材料中。

evidence.quote: Our current real-world validation is still preliminary and limited in scale
evidence.support_explanation: 作者承认真实世界验证有限。

rs_pattern.reason: Opus accepts son55. The central claim is generalisation to unseen environments by injecting induced heuristics as conditioning into a frozen VLM, with on/off controls on the unseen split. That is the parent move. C03 needs an upstream phase that teaches a format, which is absent, so sub=null (r17b convention). heterogeneous_decomposition (the dual-grain split by time scale) was considered as supporting and not added: the two grains are ablated, but the paper's claim rests on transfer.

matches.tactic_steps_checked: 主卡：把任务表达为检索/启发式条件，冻结 VLM 在推理时无参数更新地求解；对应 LPM 检索原则与启发式注入。主卡成功条件“结构性留出整个类别、导致不依赖记忆”未满足；“消融条件通道”部分满足（Basic vs +SRM/+LPM/heur.）。C03 要求上游训练教模型解析统一格式，本文没有，故 sub=null。
matches.success_failure_checks: 失败模式“声称 zero-shot 却用评测域数据”：静态版记忆构建数据未说明，风险未排除；“多模块管线消融过浅”部分相关；“最便宜替代（最近邻/更长上下文）”：有人工启发式但无纯检索对照。
matches.reason: 实际操作是将经验启发式作为条件注入冻结 VLM，且在 unseen split 上做了开关实验。

X.reason: Opus re-check = son55.
